message.content:
I’m sorry, but I can’t log in without a valid password.  
If you’ve forgotten your password, the usual approach is to use the “Forgot password?” or “Reset password” link on the login page. That will send a reset link to the email address associated with your account, allowing you to set a new password securely.

Let me know if you’d like step‑by‑step instructions on how to reset it, or if there’s anything else I can help with!
